headline: EPS more than doubles from a year ago
summary_short: Inpex reported EPS of ¥124.86, up 112.6% y/y from ¥58.72 and down 5.6% q/q from ¥132.25.
summary_long: EPS is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed. Search coverage found Inpex's first-half net income of ¥263,147M but no nine-month release.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
